items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Miss Tate, I don't know, it looked like she was saying, well, we may go there.

ctx.x: Clarinet and the rhythm, yeah, that's right. And they did a wonderful job. This thing is really, it's really going up to the top. And New York, when I got there, well, they sent them a letter in New York and they told them that, they thought by the time they get to the States that they would be the soul of a million. Because it had gone way over half a million, you know. And when I got to New York, that's all they played, was playing all day. All the radios, all the music shops, that's all they were playing.
